# Glycotide (glycotide.onrender.com)

> This site is an independent reader information site about Glycotide, a liquid-drop dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Format: liquid drops in a dropper bottle; one bottle is listed as a 30-day supply; serving size and directions are on the bottle (not given on the seller's page)
- Named ingredients: gymnema leaf extract, chromium picolinate, panax ginseng, green tea leaf extract, coleus forskohlii root extract; plus unnamed "additional plant extracts and amino acids"; no amounts given
- Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus $9.99 shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping); listed as 60, 90 and 180 days
- 60-day satisfaction guarantee; at least 30 days of use recommended; contact the support team within 60 days
- Not a treatment for diabetes or any disease; gymnema, chromium and ginseng can lower blood sugar further in people on diabetes medicine; green tea extract usually carries caffeine
